items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: I remember at times telling my wife that Art Tatum just came in town and he's around at Booker's house, and they had called me.

ctx.x: came to town... I remember at times telling my wife that Art Tatum just came in town and he's around at Booker's house, and they had called me. She said, 'Well, okay, I'll see you in a couple of days.' Because that meant I was going to be with Art Tatum all day, or I would go to work with him, then after we would hang out and we would drink and play all night at somebody's house, and everybody would fall asleep on the couch or something, and other pianists would play. There was always at least, oh, eight or ten…
In hanging out with him like that, it was always a learning thing. It was like being in school.
